tasks.action: Resolve the main branch to a full immutable commit using official GitHub commit metadata and pin the reviewed pages to that commit.
Inspect only official manifest, checksum, dataset-card and repository-tree metadata; enumerate inert paths and coverage without opening dataset records.
Read the peer-reviewed ACL paper as a document for methodology, source, privacy, annotation and rewrite-linkage evidence; do not open dataset files.
Inspect official repository history, QUICKSTART/README metadata and an official paper landing page if publicly available; do not open CSV records.
A signed-in user may later export or screenshot the complete Hugging Face gated access conditions after a separate capture protocol is frozen; accepting access is not authorized here.
If public paper evidence remains incomplete, prepare concise questions on record-level grouping/provenance, privacy/adjudication and checksums.
If public documentation remains incomplete, ask whether an investment subtype exists and request annotation, provenance, grouping and immutable split/checksum evidence.

stop_rules: Do not repeat an identical metadata query or page read already exhausted in Result V1.
Do not infer a negative fact from missing public evidence.
Do not proceed from Lane A to dataset acquisition.
Do not perform Lane B without a user-supplied gated-terms capture protocol.
Do not perform Lane C without an owner-approved publisher-contact release.
If any opened artifact is a dataset record, executable, archive, raw HTML or triggers malware/PUA detection, abandon that artifact or batch without restore or whitelist.
